pulserver.pypulseq.calc_sampled_lines

Contents

  • calc_sampled_lines()

pulserver.pypulseq.calc_sampled_lines#

pulserver.pypulseq.calc_sampled_lines(n, r, acs_lines)#

Return the sampled view indices for uniform undersampling + ACS block.

Every r-th view is sampled, plus a centered block of acs_lines autocalibration views.

Parameters:

  • n (int) – Total number of views.

  • r (int) – Acceleration factor (view i is sampled when i % r == 0).

  • acs_lines (int) – Number of fully sampled center views.

Returns:

list of int – Sorted sampled view indices.

Examples

>>> import pulserver.pypulseq as pp
>>> pp.calc_sampled_lines(8, 2, 0)
[0, 2, 4, 6]
